name: @reclose/sentinel
description: C3: Sentinel - improves liveness by monitoring configured sources, detecting CANDIDATE conditions, and building EAPs (CLAUDE.md Section 33). Sentinel NEVER decides truth and NEVER receives target-control authority: candidate detection here is a deterministic keyword/pattern check, never an LLM judgment - that remains exclusively IncidentJudgeV1's job. Sentinel also never custodies private keys; submission is a separate, explicit step the operator performs through their own wallet/keystore (e.g. `reclose evidence build` piped into `genlayer write`), never automated inside this package.
